latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of api-doc-gen — automatic API documentation generator.

- Generates API docs from Flask, Django DRF, FastAPI, and Express.js code.
- Supports output in Markdown, OpenAPI 3.0 (JSON/YAML), and Postman Collection.
- Automatically infers parameter types and docs from type hints and comments.
- Includes built-in API response templates and batch processing.
- Offers free and paid plans with feature upgrades.
